description:
You are a Computer Network Support Specialist starting your morning shift. The 'Network Support' mailbox has accumulated several tickets overnight. You need to star three critical network incident conversations for priority tracking so you can quickly access them from the Starred view throughout your shift.

In the 'Network Support' mailbox conversation list, star exactly these three conversations by clicking their star icons:

1. "Core Switch Failure - Building A"
2. "VPN Gateway Timeout Errors"
3. "DNS Resolution Failures Across Campus"

Do NOT star the other conversations (they are routine requests). After starring, the three conversations should appear in the Starred folder/view.
